priority: 2026-09-11 user: protect abundant organelle/ribosomal recovery and runtime/RAM; metagenomic and single-copy nuclear optimization deferred
limitations: Local uncompressed fixed-prefix calibration, not held-out truth; network/gzip/BLAST excluded.
Whole unchanged panels are timed; recovery is assessed by target metadata and per-product evidence, not raw total products.
Small number of paired measurements supports descriptive comparisons, not portable statistical guarantees.
40 GiB virtual-address limit is not an RSS cap or 16 GB laptop validation.
All inputs are previously inspected calibration data, not independent held-out truth.
Larger k changes coverage, observed seed context and accepted kmer workload; no coverage, primer or search-budget retuning.
Exact recovery is not independent read-supported repeat-copy truth; no release/default change is authorized.
purpose: Preregistered longer-k calibration under #153; no production/default changes or release

review_criteria.recovery: Flag every lost high-copy candidate; prioritize reference-supported and dominant products. Compare sequence membership independent of index, retain classification and median/minimum support. Do not require restoration of unsupported repeat-copy claims.
review_criteria.runtime: Report every increase; prioritize investigation of >5% per-cell paired median wall increase. Descriptive only; no automatic no-regression claim.
review_criteria.ram: Report every increase; prioritize investigation of >2% per-cell paired median RSS increase.
review_criteria.failures: Any nonzero CLI exit, timeout, resource breach, count mismatch, invalid provenance/output or BLAST evaluation error invalidates that cell.
review_criteria.deferred: Metagenomic and single-copy nuclear diversity/recovery are not current release gates.
review_criteria.release: Stop before release for user review, regardless of numeric thresholds.

confirmation_selection.eligible: k > 19; all discovery invocations and classifications valid and same-version sequence/classification stable; restores at least one of the seven exact missing high-copy products in every replicate; preserves every k19 candidate confirmed_product sequence in the affected samples in every replicate
confirmation_selection.confirmation: Three alternating pairs at selected k for the seven remaining non-insect samples from the frozen ten-sample protocol; same inputs, panels, and settings
confirmation_selection.if_none_eligible: Do not expand timings; report the result and uncertainties for user review
confirmation_selection.release_gate: Selection is exploratory calibration, not a change to default k or release approval; report every other high-copy loss and resource increase

comparison_contract.primary: Exact gene-plus-sequence membership, not product index or raw gene/product totals
comparison_contract.same_k: Both versions at each k, including aggregate read/base/kmer occurrence parity
comparison_contract.cross_k: Both versions against fixed k19 released and candidate memberships; read/base/prefix equality required, kmer occurrence totals may differ
comparison_contract.changed_endpoints: Keep exact sequence changes visible; only separately report boundary equivalence if demonstrated from frozen FASTA/panel evidence; never count as exact rescue
comparison_contract.mechanism: Retain seed/threshold/SCC/collision/node/DFS/path diagnostics; k changes seed context and effective support as well as topology, so cannot attribute every change solely to repeat resolution
comparison_contract.resources: Whole unchanged-panel wall/RSS; same-k version comparisons and within-version cross-k comparisons; three same-host repeats are descriptive
